people.name: Baal-zephon
people.line: Egyptian location where the Israelites camped before crossing the Red Sea.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Migdol
people.line: A place near the Red Sea where the Israelites camped

people.name: Pi-hahiroth
people.line: A place near the Red Sea crossing

translations.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they turn back and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, before Baal Zephon. You shall encamp opposite it by the sea.
translations.bsb: “Tell the Israelites to turn back and encamp before Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea. You are to encamp by the sea, directly opposite Baal-zephon.
translations.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they turn and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baalzephon: before it shall ye encamp by the sea.
translations.asv: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they turn back and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, before Baal-zephon: over against it shall ye encamp by the sea.
